rules.theme-applied: The theme's CSS is on the page and applies.
rules.token-colors: Every colour the app draws is one of the theme's colour tokens (or a mix of two).
rules.token-fonts: Text is set in the theme's fonts.
rules.token-overrides: The app does not set --piq-* tokens; the theme does.
rules.widget-overrides: The app does not restyle SDK widgets.
rules.sdk-widgets: Icons, the logo, loaders and controls come from the SDK, not drawn by the app.
rules.outside-theme: Everything visible is inside the themed element.
rules.brand: The page's favicon and logo follow the theme.
rules.fonts: The theme's fonts are loaded, from the SDK.
rules.contrast: Text meets WCAG AA contrast (axe color-contrast).
rules.reflow: The page does not scroll sideways at the audited width (WCAG 1.4.10 at 320px).
rules.target-size: Pointer targets are at least the theme's minimum target size (WCAG 2.5.8).
rules.focus-obscured: A focused control is never hidden behind sticky or fixed content (WCAG 2.4.11).
